parquet_to_csv.clickhouse: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('{out}/out.csv', CSVWithNames) SELECT * FROM file('{data}/parquet/lineitem.parquet', Parquet)

parquet_to_parquet.clickhouse: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('{out}/out.parquet', Parquet) SELECT * FROM file('{data}/parquet/lineitem.parquet', Parquet)

csv_to_parquet.clickhouse: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('{out}/out.parquet', Parquet) SELECT * FROM file('{data}/csv/lineitem.csv', CSVWithNames)

csvgz_to_parquet.clickhouse: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('{out}/out.parquet', Parquet) SELECT * FROM file('{data}/csv/lineitem.csv.gz', CSVWithNames)

ndjson_to_parquet.clickhouse: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('{out}/out.parquet', Parquet) SELECT * FROM file('{data}/ndjson/lineitem.ndjson', JSONEachRow)

orders_transform.basalt: LOAD INTO '{out}/out.parquet' AS SELECT o_orderkey, upper(o_orderpriority) AS priority, o_totalprice * 1.1 AS adjusted, o_orderdate FROM '{data}/parquet/orders.parquet' WHERE o_orderdate >= CAST('1995-01-01' AS DATE);
orders_transform.duckdb: COPY (SELECT o_orderkey, upper(o_orderpriority) AS priority, o_totalprice * 1.1 AS adjusted, o_orderdate FROM read_parquet('{data}/parquet/orders.parquet') WHERE o_orderdate >= CAST('1995-01-01' AS DATE)) TO '{out}/out.parquet' (FORMAT parquet);
orders_transform.clickhouse: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('{out}/out.parquet', Parquet) SELECT o_orderkey, upper(o_orderpriority) AS priority, o_totalprice * 1.1 AS adjusted, o_orderdate FROM file('{data}/parquet/orders.parquet', Parquet) WHERE o_orderdate >= CAST('1995-01-01' AS DATE)
orders_transform.datafusion:
